_comment: Tool names a skill-policy.json `allowed_tools` entry may use. Checked by
scripts/validate_catalog.py; a name that is not a real tool silently grants nothing.
Go engine (the default; aria-code go/runtime/skills.go): a turn that
activates a skill ($name or /skills use) offers its allowed_tools. Older
Python names map to Go tools there (skillToolAliases): get_market_data,
optimize_positions and analyze_news to financial-service tools,
analyze_file to read_file, generate_image and edit_image to Aria's own
tool server (aria.report.*). Add a name here and an alias there together.
Python engine (until it is removed): apps/cli/local_tool_schemas.py,
matched by short name (mcp__<server>__<short_name>), such as the research-run
tools of an external research server. Fully-qualified mcp__<server>__<tool>
names are accepted without being listed here.
